title: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The scaling relationship of compute and performance for language models (LMs) has been extensively studied; more recently, models are being designed to scale memory use, as well. In particular, adding embeddings for n-grams scales memory separately from compute use, because each pass only processes individual embedding rows, which are much smaller than the storage used for the whole embedding table. However, existing methods train embeddings from scratch, which needs expensive GPU memory for fast reading and writing. Meanwhile, the ordinary memory of the host system is cheap and underutilized by these training methods. To scale on host memory, we introduce COUNT (Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers), which builds n-gram embeddings without adding learned parameters by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host. translated_title: The COUNT：通过计数N-gram解锁主机内存上的扩展与免训练适配
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LMs）的计算与性能之间的缩放关系已被广泛研究；最近，模型也被设计为能够扩展内存使用。特别是，为n-gram添加嵌入可以使内存扩展与计算使用相互独立，因为每次前向传播只处理单个嵌入行，其大小远小于整个嵌入表所占用的存储空间。然而，现有方法需要从头训练嵌入，这需要昂贵的GPU内存来进行快速读写。与此同时，主机系统的普通内存价格低廉，却在这些训练方法中未被充分利用。为了在主机内存上实现扩展，我们提出了COUNT（Counting Offline Unlocks N-gram Transformers），它通过在主机上存储预计算的n-gram计数来构建n-gram嵌入，而无需添加任何可学习参数。我们利用语料库频率，对语言模型自身的unembedding进行加权组合，以表示最常跟随当前上下文的后继词元……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出COUNT方法，通过在廉价的主机内存上存储预计算的n-gram计数并结合语言模型自身的unembedding来构建n-gram嵌入，无需训练新参数，从而实现主机内存上的扩展与免训练适配。
en_tdlr: COUNT builds n-gram embeddings by storing precomputed n-gram counts on host memory and weighting the LM's own unembeddings, requiring no learned parameters and enabling scaling on cheap host memory with training-free adaptation.
